title: Ben Rich's UCLA speech
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ben Rich's UCLA speech, about 1990s at UCLA, California, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: at a UCLA speech in the '90s, towards the end of his life, Ben Rich, the former director of Skunk Works, made some very strange comments
Ben Rich was the you know president of skunk works that says we have you know uh the power to travel the stars to take ET home
tellings.difference: Gives the 'take ET home' wording without naming UCLA as the venue.
tellings.link_reason: Rich's 1990s line about having the means to travel the stars and take ET home is the remark from his UCLA speech.

as_told.title: Ben Rich's statements on taking ET home

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Ben Rich, the former head of Skunk Works, the secret aircraft design unit of the company Lockheed, made some very strange comments during a speech at UCLA, a university in Los Angeles, in the 1990s near the end of his life. In another episode Michels gives the words as saying the US had the power to travel to the stars and "take ET home," meaning return an alien visitor. If true, it would mean a top insider hinted that the country already had technology for space travel far beyond what is known.
